diagram3d.configuration.title: Diagram 3D Configuration
diagram3d.configuration.enabled.tooltip: Enable or disable the entire mod.
diagram3d.configuration.radius.tooltip: The radius around the player within which information about sublevels is requested from the server.
diagram3d.configuration.force_group_conf:
Configure the display settings for individual force groups.
Press the §eToggle Key§r while in a world to open the configuration.
diagram3d.configuration.vector_style.too: Choose the visual style used to render vectors.
diagram3d.configuration.proportional_vec:
Controls the §alinear§r component of vector scaling.

§bP§r = linear scaling factor
§dQ§r = quadratic scaling factor
§7x§r = original size

The resulting scale is:
§dQ§r × §7x§r² + §bP§r × §7x§r
diagram3d.configuration.quadratic_vector:
Controls the §dquadratic§r component of vector scaling.

§bP§r = linear scaling factor
§dQ§r = quadratic scaling factor
§7x§r = original size

The resulting scale is:
§dQ§r × §7x§r² + §bP§r × §7x§r
diagram3d.configuration.display_center_o:
Choose how centers of mass are displayed.

§bIcon§r: Display only the icon.
§eDetails§r: Always display detailed information.
§aDynamic Details§r: Display detailed information only when looking at a center of mass.
diagram3d.configuration.display_vectors_:
Choose when detailed information about vectors is displayed.

§cDisabled§r: Do not display information.
§eAlways§r: Always display detailed information.
§aDynamic Details§r: Display detailed information only when looking at a vector.
diagram3d.configuration.info_background_:
Set the background color of information displays.
Only applies when "Information Textured Background" is disabled.
Use a textured background for information displays.
diagram3d.configuration.gui_background_c:
Set the background color of the custom GUI.
Only applies when "GUI Textured Background" is disabled.
diagram3d.configuration.gui_background_u: Use a textured background for the custom GUI.
